legend.title: Legend
legend.mecatol: Mecatol Rex at the centre of the map.
legend.system: An ordinary system. The number in its corner is the tile on the table.
legend.anomaly: An anomaly: asteroids, nebula, supernova, rift or scar. Its caption names it.
legend.wormhole: A system with a wormhole; its sign stands by the number.
legend.hyperlane: A hyperlane: its lines join the systems around it.
legend.free: An empty place: no tile yet.
legend.active: The active system of a tactical action, or the system of the action you are reading.
legend.source: A source: ships leave from here.
legend.path: A system on the way of a flight.
legend.valid: Fits the current choice: tap it.
legend.values: Gold is resources, blue is influence. The ring's colour: the planet is yours.
legend.control: The ring's colour shows who controls the planet.
legend.exhausted: An exhausted planet is struck through and dimmed.
legend.tech: A technology specialty: propulsion, biotic, cybernetic, warfare.
legend.trait: The tint of a trait: cultural, hazardous, industrial.
legend.legendary: A gold mark: a legendary planet.
legend.command: Your command token: the system was already activated this round.
legend.activated: Activated system: your command token lies in it, ships cannot leave it.
legend.ingress: An ingress token of the Fracture.
legend.seat: A player's seat number at their home system.
legend.routeActive: The route of the action you are editing or reading.
legend.routeGap: Dashed: a jump between hexes that do not touch (the Fracture, a portal, an ability), one step.
legend.routeNumber: The tactical action's number in the round, the same as in the plan.
legend.routePickup: How many units the flight picks up in this system on the way.
legend.totals: The totals on top: now → forecast, when they differ.
legend.forecast: The map and totals with the whole plan of the round.
legend.now: Only what is already marked as done.
legend.rowEdit: Edit the action. A tap on its name only shows it.

unit.flagship: : the faction's unique ship, one per game.
unit.warsun: : the strongest ship, unlocked by a technology.
unit.dreadnought: : a heavy ship that bombards planets.
unit.destroyer: : a cheap ship that hits fighters before combat.
unit.pds: : fires at ships in its system.

builder.title: Set the tile
builder.unknown: No tile "{{query}}" in the game data.
builder.ambiguous: "{{query}}" has two sides: pick one, for example {{query}}A.
builder.duplicates: Tile placed more than once: {{list}}. This is allowed.
builder.empty: Empty slots: {{count}}. Tap a slot and type the number, or paste a Milty string.
builder.complete: The map is built: every slot is filled ({{count}}).
builder.note: Tap a slot to set its tile number. Mecatol Rex, the home systems and the hyperlanes are placed by themselves. Drag a player's number to another seat, or tap one number and then another: the players swap seats. Player 1 is your faction, marked with a white ring.
builder.noteStarted: Tap a slot to set its tile number. Once the game has started, the layout and the seats stay.

plan.noGame: Start or open a game first.
plan.name: Plan name
plan.mapIncomplete: The map is not complete: {{count}} empty slots.

cards.hint: Tap once for the details, again for backup, a third time for main, once more to clear. A tap outside this block goes back to the main card. The card is played in the action phase.
cards.hintTwo: With 3 or 4 players two cards are held. Tap once for the details, again for the second card, a third time for main, once more to clear. A tap outside this block goes back to the main card. Cards are played in the action phase.

entries.label: Label
entries.scoredHint: A secret objective leaves the hand; a public one is revealed for the whole game. Enter its points above.
entries.spendHint: The objectives that are scored by spending: tokens from the pools, trade goods, planets exhausted.
entries.planetsRefresh: Planets refresh at the start of the next round.
entries.changeUnits: Tap to change the units in the big hex

tactical.title: Tactical action
tactical.pickHint: Tap the system to activate: it spends a tactic token.
tactical.moveHint: Drag from any system to the active one through the hexes you need, or back from the active one, or tap the system and then the hexes in turn. A source nothing is taken from does not stay in the action.
tactical.freeToken: Warfare: no tactic token is spent and no command token goes down.
tactical.freePickHint: Tap the system for the Warfare tactical action: no tactic token is spent.
tactical.noSources: Drag the first arrow or add a source.
tactical.wrongSystem: Wrong system? Tap this field to choose another, or tap the system again.
tactical.addSourceHint: Tap the system the ships come from.
tactical.noShipsAtStart: No ships where the route starts.
tactical.tapHint: Tap the hexes in order or drag on from the last one, and finish on the active system. A tap on the last hex removes it.

picker.title: Flight {{from}} → {{to}}
picker.noRoom: No room for cargo: the ships have nothing to carry it in.
picker.tokenHere: Your command token is here: by the rules nothing can be picked up, the app will warn

warning.shortResources: Not enough resources: need {{needed}}, paid {{paid}}, short by {{short}}.
warning.shortInfluence: Not enough influence: need {{needed}}, paid {{paid}}, short by {{short}}.
warning.shortTradeGoods: Not enough trade goods: need {{needed}}, have {{have}}.
warning.capacityGroup: Group from {{from}} is over capacity: {{load}} of {{capacity}}.
warning.fleetPool: System {{system}} is over the fleet pool: {{ships}} ships, {{fleet}} tokens.
warning.primaryRepeated: The primary has already been played this round: cards held {{held}}.
warning.tokensOver: Distributed {{given}} tokens with {{free}} free: more usually from abilities or technologies.
warning.poolNegative: {{pool}}: not enough tokens, the pool goes below zero ({{have}}).
warning.systemHasToken: {{system}} already holds your token: by the rules it cannot be activated again.
warning.constructionUnits: The card text gives the secondary a structure only: building units here may break the rules.
warning.speedShort: {{unit}} from {{from}} has speed {{move}}, and the route takes {{steps}} steps.
warning.sourceActivated: {{from}} already holds your command token: by the rules ships cannot move out of it.
warning.routeBlocked: The route from {{from}} runs into {{system}}: by the rules asteroids, a supernova, a nebula and other players' ships do not let it pass.
warning.noReinforcements: Tokens in play: {{total}}, but a faction has only {{limit}}: with none left in reinforcements no token can be gained.
warning.actionAfterPass: You have already passed this round: by the rules no more actions follow, only other players' secondaries.
warning.passBeforeStrategy: The pass comes before the strategic action of your card (cards left: {{cards}}): by the rules a player passes only after it.
warning.actionOutsidePhase: Turns are taken only in the action phase: this action stands in another phase.
warning.planetNotControlled: {{planet}} is not your planet: by the rules you exhaust only planets you control.
warning.readyNotControlled: {{planet}} is not your planet: an effect readies only planets you control.
warning.foreignPrimary: This strategy card is not yours this round: its holder resolves the primary ability.
warning.ownSecondary: This strategy card is yours: only the other players resolve its secondary ability.
warning.secondaryRepeated: The secondary ability of this card has already been resolved this round.
warning.readyOverLimit: {{readied}} planets readied, and the card allows at most {{limit}}.
warning.diplomacySystem: {{system}}: Diplomacy picks a system with your planet, other than the Mecatol Rex system.
warning.researchOverLimit: {{count}} technologies researched, and this ability gives at most {{limit}}.
warning.researchOwned: {{name}}: the technology is already researched and is not researched again.
warning.componentNotHeld: {{name}}: you do not hold this component at this point.
warning.componentNotHeld_transaction: {{name}}: the side that gives it does not hold this component at this point.
warning.componentExhausted: {{name}} is exhausted: it is readied only in the status phase.
warning.ownPromissory: {{name}}: a player cannot play their own promissory note.
warning.shipOnPlanet: {{unit}} is a ship and cannot land on {{planet}}: only ground forces land.
warning.landingOutsideSystem: {{planet}} is not in the active system {{system}}: ground forces land only there.
warning.custodians: The custodians token is still on {{planet}}: removing it costs 6 influence, which the plan does not record; the first to land gains 1 victory point.
warning.structureLimit: Too many structures: a planet holds one space dock and two PDS; Construction places up to two (one dock at most), its secondary one; the reinforcements hold 3 docks and 6 PDS.
warning.structureLimit_planet: {{planet}} holds more than two PDS: a planet holds at most two.
warning.structureNotControlled: {{planet}} is not your planet: structures go only on planets you control.
warning.structureOutsideSystem: {{planet}} is not in {{system}}, where the secondary placed its token.
warning.noProduction: {{system}} has no unit of yours with Production for this: an opponent's space dock does not count, and a card may need the one in your home system.
warning.productionBlockaded: {{system}} holds other players' ships: by the rules ships cannot be produced there, ground forces can.
warning.blockaded: Your space dock in {{system}} is blockaded: other players' ships and none of yours, so it produces no ships.
warning.productionOver: Production {{value}}, and {{count}} units are built: each fighter and infantry counts.
warning.reinforcementsOut: {{unit}}: {{have}} of {{limit}} are already on the board, the reinforcements hold no more.
warning.productionPlace: {{planet}} has no space dock of yours that produces: ground forces go to the planet with the dock.
warning.scarProduction: {{system}} is an entropic scar: units in it cannot use Production.
warning.expeditionUnpaid: The technology part is paid by exhausting a ready planet of yours with a technology specialty.
warning.expeditionTwicePerTurn: One expedition part per turn: this is the second one since your last action.
warning.stationGround: {{planet}} is a space station: ground forces cannot land on it.
warning.stationStructure: {{planet}} is a space station: structures cannot be placed on it.
warning.routeBlocked_hyperlane: The route from {{from}} ends on the hyperlane {{system}}: by the rules a hyperlane is no system, it cannot be the active system and no move ends there.
warning.sourceActivated_pickup: {{system}} holds your command token: by the rules units cannot be picked up there, only in the active system.
warning.pickupOffRoute: Units are picked up in {{system}}, off the way of the ships from {{from}}: by the rules a ship picks units up only where it starts, passes or ends its move.
warning.transactionRepeated: No more than one transaction with a player in a turn.
warning.notNeighbor: A transaction is only with a neighbour: you need units or planets in the same or adjacent systems.
warning.transactionNotes: No more than one promissory note from each side of a transaction.
warning.transactionKind: {{name}}: a transaction does not hand this over, only trade goods, commodities, promissory notes and relic fragments.

Twilight Imperium and related names are trademarks of their respective owners. No game art or components are included.

data.title: Game data
data.text: Systems, planets, units and card sets are built from the public repository
data.wording: Card, technology and ability texts belong to the publisher of the game: they are quoted verbatim in English, and the Russian interface shows their translation. Terms follow the English Rules Reference and the Russian edition by Hobby World. The data may contain mistakes; where it differs, the official rules win.

components.title: Components
components.typeToSearch: One line searches the name, kind, faction, attributes and text of a card, words in any order: "agent Hacan", "blue technology", "law".
components.leadersHint: An exhausted agent readies in the status phase. A commander unlocks by its condition and is never exhausted. A hero is purged once it is used.

uses.title: Used
uses.hint: What was used this turn beside the action itself: an agent, a technology, an ability. What they allow is marked among the warnings.

gains.title: Taken and discarded
gains.hint: From a deck or the supply, and to the discard or out of the game. Giving to another player is in a transaction.
